evidence: Purdue's 2018 Gateway planning source depicts typical Levels 2–4 and existing Levels 1–4 at 14 ft 8 in floor-to-floor; saved L1–L4 intervals are approximately 4.480 m, within about 0.011 m.
2017 Purdue source supports a 28-panel photovoltaic installation; roof imagery supports broad roof/terrace forms qualitatively.
findings: L5 occupied-floor versus roof-slab status is explicitly UNVERIFIED / SOURCE CONFLICT.
Penthouse geometry and exact roof equipment/panel layout are not measured; the PV arrangement is schematic and dates from 2017 source evidence.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: Purdue Archives exterior photographs and Purdue Polytechnic imagery show the stepped brick massing, brick-heavy facades, horizontal glazing bands, and entrance vocabulary represented by the saved model.

The reopened exterior render shows stepped volumes, brick/window rhythm, parapet bands, modeled entry canopy/sign, and roof PV; the saved brick shader has metre-scale course values with an oblique close-up.
Purdue's 2018 typical-level plan and Liu's ground-plan evidence support the modeled interior partitions, doors, and upper stair-core placements as approximate source-derived geometry.
findings: Facade openings and rooftop forms have no calibrated, edge-specific elevation/photo fit; presentation detail is stronger than dimensional proof.
Interior registration and door/stair dimensions remain estimates, with some candidate door gaps unresolved.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: The actual saved Blender 5.2.3 file reopens in scene Building_knoy_hall, with 191 scene objects, 169 meshes, expected Asset_knoy_hall collection (158 contained objects), and identity asset root.

Building-specific evidence includes raw GIS, source provenance, reopen validation, facade and plan imagery, roof/level caveats, and explicit source-ID reconciliation.
findings: This library-asset audit does not prove successful placement in the full campus master.
